# TreeView

## TreeView family

A hierarchical list of nodes that expand, collapse and select, walked by
the keyboard. TreeNode carries `requires_parent` (a node draws only inside
a TreeView) and `no_reference` (measured through the tree's samples).

### Decisions

Nodes come as `nodes` data (samples cannot carry element children, as
TileGroup's `items`, D21a); TreeNode is the row the context renders. The
depth indent is upstream's `calcOffset` verbatim in `control.tree_indent`
units.

Only the focused node is a tab stop: each node takes `tabIndex` -1 and the
focused one 0 (upstream `TreeNode.js:281`, `TreeView.js:112`), passed
explicitly because a react-native-web `Pressable` otherwise gives every
enabled node 0.

### U2 repair (upstream quoted)

Probe `TreeView.json`: the tree paints nothing and each row paints the
container cell; the label carries the hover and selected fills, the ring
and the ink (`labels` cells). Upstream nests a child row in its parent's 16
padding (depth-1 rows x 52, width 304) and the label cancels the sum to span
the tree (label x 0, width 320, margin-left -40 / -16 / -56, padding-left the
same, padding-right 16); our flat rows step in by `depth * indent` and the
label reaches back over that and the row's start padding. The active bar is
an overlay at the tree's edge, as upstream's `::before` (row border 0). The
toggle box pulls back by `control.tree_toggle_offset` and keeps it after
(toggle x 48, margin -4 / 4) and draws the 16 caret. The label sits
`spacing_03` above the tree (`form/_form.scss` `cds--label` margin-block-end).
Rows take `minHeight`, so scaled text grows them. The reference passes each
row's `id`, as the probe mount does: upstream selection keys on it.

### Platform

`platform.support` is `both`.

## TreeNode

TreeNode is one row of a TreeView - an expandable parent or a selectable leaf with an optional icon, indented by its depth; it must be composed inside TreeView, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through the tree's samples.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `none` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `compound-context`, `keyboard` |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent; `no_reference` - no upstream visual reference; gates are structural, accessibility and cross-template |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `node` | no | Nested TreeNodes. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables the node. |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | no | A controlled expanded state for a parent. |
| `href` | `string` | no | The node is a link. |
| `icon` | `string` | no | A semantic icon name drawn before the label. |
| `id` | `string` | no | The node id used by the tree's selection. |
| `label` | `string` | no | The node's text. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the node. |

| `iconGap` | `control.tree_icon_gap` |
| `toggleOffset` | `control.tree_toggle_offset` |
| `labelPaddingEnd` | `control.tree_label_padding_end` |
| `focusWidth` | `control.tree_focus_width` |
| `indicatorWidth` | `control.tree_node_indicator_width` |
| `paddingStart` | `control.tree_node_padding_start` |
| `leafPaddingBlock` | `control.tree_leaf_padding_block` |

## TreeView

TreeView is a hierarchical list of nodes that expand, collapse and select, one at a time or several, walked by the arrow keys under an optional visible label.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `compound-context`, `keyboard` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | `one` | no | The controlled active node id. |
| `defaultActive` | `one` | no | The initial active node id for the uncontrolled form. |
| `defaultSelected` | `array` | no | The initial selected node ids for the uncontrolled form. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | no | Hides the visible label; an accessibilityLabel is required instead. |
| `label` | `string` | no | The visible field label. |
| `multiselect` | `boolean` | no | Several nodes can be selected. |
| `nodes` | `array` | yes | The tree data: `{ id, label, disabled, expanded, children, icon, href }`; children nest the same shape. |
| `onSelect` | `function` | no | Called with the selected node. |
| `onToggle` | `function` | no | Called with the toggled node and its expanded state. |
| `selected` | `array` | no | The controlled selected node ids. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `xs`, `sm`. Default `sm`. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the tree. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `indent` | `control.tree_indent` |
| `toggleSize` | `control.tree_toggle_size` |
| `toggleOffset` | `control.tree_toggle_offset` |
| `iconSize` | `control.tree_icon_size` |
| `iconGap` | `control.tree_icon_gap` |
| `focusWidth` | `control.tree_focus_width` |
| `indicatorWidth` | `control.tree_node_indicator_width` |
| `paddingStart` | `control.tree_node_padding_start` |
| `leafPaddingBlock` | `control.tree_leaf_padding_block` |
| `leafPaddingStart` | `control.tree_leaf_padding_start` |
| `leafPaddingStartIcon` | `control.tree_leaf_padding_start_icon` |
| `leafPaddingStartNestedIcon` | `control.tree_leaf_padding_start_nested_icon` |
| `labelTextPaddingStart` | `control.tree_label_text_padding_start` |
| `labelPaddingEnd` | `control.tree_label_padding_end` |
| `labelGap` | `spacing.spacing_03` |
| `heightSmall` | `size.size_xsmall` |
| `heightMedium` | `size.size_small` |
